source_snapshot: All tracked fastunknot package files, the baseline integration-test fixture, LICENSE and pyproject.toml from the pinned commit, plus exactly five new implementation/test files.

patch_validation.validation: Applied to an isolated tree extracted from the pinned baseline; compared every added byte and all pre-existing file hashes.

dispatcher_policy: Opt-in supplied-sector APIs; the default recognizer and dispatcher are unchanged.
scope: Complete non-link standard-ray enumeration in a supplied compatible sector of matching nullity at most three; no global quasi-polynomial unknot-recognition result is claimed.
source_hash_notes: Historical audit JSON keeps the source hashes at execution. An early certificate wrapper was corrected to charge kernel preparation to its whole-query allowance. The final full regression, portable quick tests, independent audits and full corpus with fresh Regina replay use the delivered source. The checker docstring also received a complexity-accounting clarification.
unimplemented_mathematical_extension: Effective-dimension recompilation after one-LP maximal-support extraction, with exact primal/dual support witnesses. Runtime still gates raw nullity at most three.

unimplemented_euler_precheck.theory: Convex link-nonnegative canonical objectives attain their maximum at original quadrilateral-section corners; Euler-only query has O(1+t+k^2) post-kernel rational arithmetic cost with aggregated Euler coefficients.
unimplemented_euler_precheck.scope: Not integrated into runtime or certificate APIs; no benchmark speedup attributed to it. The separate exact-data audit checks normalized maxima and standard-ray corner membership.

euler_corner_audit.interpretation: Exact normalized Euler maxima and corner membership, not a timing of the proposed precheck.
